meta_description: PG Decorators Sheffield — interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decoration. Local, reliable, competitive quotes.
hero_subhead: Transform your home or business with professional interior and exterior decoration. Free quotes, no obligation.
services_subhead: From interior room refreshes to full exterior repaints, we handle every job with care and attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh any room with expert interior decoration. We prepare surfaces properly, select the right finishes, and leave your home spotless. Colours that last, applied with precision.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and enhance your property's exterior with quality exterior paint and render work. Weather-resistant finishes keep your home looking fresh for years.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging for feature walls or complete rooms. We source quality papers and apply them flawlessly, with clean, sharp finishes.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting, frames, and cupboards deserve expert finishing. We sand, prime, and paint timber work to a furniture-maker standard.

services.title: Commercial Decoration
services.desc: Offices, retail units, and hospitality spaces. We work efficiently to minimise disruption and deliver professional results on time and budget.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Treatment
services.desc: Proper prep is everything. Damp proof work, crack repair, and surface preparation ensure paint and finishes adhere perfectly and last longer.

about_pullquote: We do the prep work nobody notices so the finish speaks for itself.
about_para_1: PG Decorators was established in Sheffield over 15 years ago. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, built on word-of-mouth recommendations and repeat customers. We've decorated hundreds of Sheffield homes and businesses, from period properties to modern new builds.
about_para_2: Our reputation rests on meticulous preparation, honest communication, and finishing standards that other decorators simply don't match. We turn up on time, protect your furniture and floors, and tidy up properly. Customers come back because we treat their home like our own.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Paul came round for a quote, turned up on time, and gave me a honest assessment of what needed doing. Three weeks later the job was finished — walls look immaculate, and he left the house spotless. Not the cheapest, but worth every penny.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had the front of the house repainted and woodwork done. Paul took his time with prep, explained everything, and the finish is brilliant. Neighbours have already asked for his number. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Christine W.

reviews.text: Two large bedrooms wallpapered and interior repaint. Turned up when promised, left no mess, and the attention to detail is obvious. Will definitely use again when we redecorate downstairs.
reviews.author: David L.
